article.title: Rikers Island Set To Close in 2032 & SRG To Be Disbanded
article.author: The Thorn - NYC DSA Electoral Working Group
article.content: Local News In a video collaboration with New York City Councilmember Chi Osse (Council District 36, Bedford–Stuyvesant), Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the official disbandment of the NYPD’s Strategic Response Group (SRG), addressing a campaign promise to separate protest response from counterterrorism functions. The SRG will be replaced with a civilian-led Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division (CDDD), and the NYPD’s protest response will be through a specialized dialogue team, named the First Amendment Support Team (FAST). Rikers Island—notorious for its overcrowding, inmate/correctional violence, and egregious living conditions— is set to shut its doors in 2032 . In place of Rikers Island will be four borough jails opening between 2029 and 2032, and the overall inmate population is intended to be reduced from 6,700 to approximately 4,000. Mayor Mamdani signed Romanch’s Law , officially banning horse-drawn carriages , effective June 2028. Per the Pied-à-Terre tax, 7,489 homes in New York City were collectively billed over $563 million . Amazon has been pushing in-app warnings against the New York City Council’s Intro 518, or the Delivery Protection Act , claiming the legislation “could increase fees for New Yorkers by up to $5.00 per order.” The International Brotherhood of Teamsters and Mayor Mamdani support the bill. The MTA proposed fare hikes for the subway, buses, Long Island Rail Road, and Metro-North in 2027. Additionally, congestion pricing is also set to increase in 2028. New York Attorney General Letitia James unveiled the AI Safety Enforcement Unit , which aims to address data privacy risks and chatbots manipulating children. Election News Congressman Hakeem Jeffries (NY-8) is expected to become the first Black Speaker of the United States House of Representatives, with 251 House Democrats voting in favor of proposing him. 11 Democrats, however, voted against his nomination. Two nays came from incoming Congresswomen Claire Valdez (NY-7) and Daraliaza Avila Chevalier (NY-13). A joint statement with them and five other progressive members was released , addressing work needed to be done for Hakeem Jeffries to combat ICE terror, the Iran War, ending the genocide in Gaza, and supporting Medicare for All.
